changelog: Admin-defined questions now appear on the profile (#1803): `GET /api/forms/active`, `GET|PUT /api/forms/responses` (answers written only by their owner, validated with the shared `validateResponse()`), and the `DynamicFields` renderer mounted in `ProfileForm`.

en: Questions your programme adds now appear on your profile — answer them in your language and edit them any time.
tr: Programınızın eklediği sorular artık profilinizde — kendi dilinizde cevaplayın, istediğiniz zaman düzenleyin.
de: Fragen, die Ihr Programm hinzufügt, erscheinen jetzt in Ihrem Profil – beantworten Sie sie in Ihrer Sprache und ändern Sie sie jederzeit.
